title: Creative Producer - VintedGo, Brand Marketing
description:
## Information about the position 

As our Creative Producer for VintedGo, you'll own the creation of high-volume digital performance content for social and paid channels. Working alongside the VintedGo Marketing Manager and reporting to our Creative Production Team Lead, you'll commission and manage agencies, creators and UGC platforms, running each project from brief to final delivery, budget included.

You'll use AI and automation to scale output and keep costs down, and turn performance data into the next round of outstanding creative across our many markets, especially the US.

In this position, you will:
Own the production of Digital Performance content for VintedGo, with a focus on high-volume output to grow Social and other paid video channels.
Partner with the VintedGo Marketing Manager to set and manage expectations, holding a defined level of ambition for each production within agreed budgets and timelines.
Commission and manage external partners, from digital agencies to creators and UGC platforms, acting as their main point of contact. This covers fee negotiation, contract signing, usage rights and production planning.
Lead both creative and execution single-handedly, working in an agile way from brief to final delivery.
Own project's budget from initial estimate through cost and asset tracking to final reconciliation and reporting. 
Manage post-production, including retouching, editing, grading, sound, motion graphics, and any licensing and clearance requirements.
Own creative iterations based on trends, ad science and ready to use data insights.
Deliver finalised content and archive it in our internal systems.

## About you 

Proven experience managing high volumes of Performance or paid SoMe / UGC content across multiple markets (previous work with US mandatory, EU a plus).
Proven experience with platform-native formats and workflows (eg. TikTok One content suite etc).
Experience with integrating AI and automation within content creation, with focus on scaling and cost optimisation.
Strong networking and negotiation skills, with an existing portfolio of external partners and contacts.
Strong stakeholder management skills, comfortable running multiple projects at once.
Able to interpret basic performance data and apply the learnings to future content, as well as to adapt plans based on feedback.
A clear and concise communicator who champions VintedGo's values with every external partner.
Up to date on visual, audio and digital trends, and on commissioning best practice in the fast-moving creator market.
Work well under pressure, manage highly fluid situations with a certain degree of uncertainty, making the most of an agile and flexible mindset.
Fluent in spoken and written English.

*Platforms including but not limited to Meta, Snapchat, TikTok, YouTube, Discover, Google Play, Display and Search Networks, Pinterest and AppLovin.

## Work perks 

The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
25 working days of holiday
Access to all the tools & tech needed for work
Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
Private health insurance
Pension plan with flexible contribution options and a matching contribution from Vinted
Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
Frequent team-building events
A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
A dog-friendly office
Gym & in-house meals at friendly prices

title: Prozessmanager Accounting, Schwerpunkt Automatisierung & KI (m/w/d)
summary: Optimize accounting processes using automation and AI technologies.
description:
### Über Chrono24
Chrono24 ist der weltweit führende Marktplatz für Luxusuhren. Millionen Uhrenliebhaber und Tausende Händler in über 100 Ländern vertrauen auf unsere Plattform. Unser Finance-Team sorgt dafür, dass dieses Wachstum auf einem soliden, effizienten und zukunftsfähigen Fundament steht.

### Deine Rolle
Du verbindest fundiertes Accounting-Know-how mit einem klaren Blick für effiziente Abläufe. Du analysierst unsere Prozesse in der Buchhaltung einschließlich des Zahlungsverkehrs und machst sie schlanker, standardisierter und automatisierter. Dabei führst du nicht nur neue Tools ein, sondern holst auch mehr aus unseren bestehenden Systemen heraus. KI ist für dich ein wichtiges Werkzeug: Als AI Champion im Finance-Bereich erkennst du, wo sie echten Mehrwert schafft, und bringst das Team dabei mit. Du bist Treiber, Umsetzer und Ansprechpartner und berichtest direkt an den Director Finance.

### Darauf kannst Du dich freuen
Du analysierst die End-to-End-Prozesse im Accounting (u. a. Kreditoren, Debitoren, Hauptbuch, Monats- und Jahresabschluss nach HGB) und machst Schwachstellen und manuelle Tätigkeiten sichtbar.
Du optimierst die Payment-Prozesse, insbesondere Zahlungsabgleiche, die Abstimmung mit Payment Service Providern, Treuhandzahlungen, Auszahlungen an Händler sowie das Clearing offener Posten.
Du entwickelst Verbesserungsvorschläge und setzt sie gemeinsam mit dem Team um, von der Standardisierung bis zur Automatisierung.
Du optimierst bestehende Tools und Systeme, nutzt ihre Möglichkeiten besser aus und führst dort, wo es sinnvoll ist, neue Lösungen ein.
Du identifizierst konkrete Use Cases für KI (z. B. Belegverarbeitung, Kontierung, Zahlungszuordnung, Abstimmungen, Abweichungsanalysen, Dokumentation) und setzt sie um.
Du baust Prototypen, testest sie im Alltag und skalierst, was funktioniert.
Du stellst sicher, dass alle Lösungen den Anforderungen an Ordnungsmäßigkeit, GoBD und IKS entsprechen.
Du schulst und befähigst Kolleginnen und Kollegen und verankerst eine Kultur der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung.
Du arbeitest eng mit allen Finance-Teams und dem Data-Team zusammen.
Du beteiligst dich an unseren Transformationsprojekten, insbesondere ERP.

### Was Dich auszeichnet
Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, Weiterbildung (z. B. Bilanzbuchhalter) oder Studium mit Schwerpunkt Rechnungswesen
Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Accounting, idealerweise mit Berührungspunkten zu Payments oder Zahlungsverkehr
Sichere Kenntnisse im HGB, IFRS wären von Vorteil
Sichere Anwendung von DATEV sowie Erfahrung mit gängigen ERP-Systemen (z.B. SAP oder Oracle)
Kenntnisse in LucaNet sind von Vorteil
Erste praktische Erfahrung mit Prozessoptimierung, Automatisierung oder KI-Tools (z. B. ChatGPT/Claude, Copilot, RPA, Power Automate, Excel-Makros, Python oder SQL); du musst kein Entwickler sein, solltest aber gerne selbst ausprobieren
Analytisches Denken, Hands-on-Mentalität und die Fähigkeit, andere für Veränderungen zu gewinnen
Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse

### Was wir Dir bieten
Eine Schlüsselrolle mit großem Gestaltungsspielraum
Die Möglichkeit, die Zukunft des Accountings bei Chrono24 aktiv zu prägen
Ein internationales, dynamisches Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen

title: Head of Controlling (f/m/d)
summary: Oversee financial planning, analysis, and reporting to support strategic decisions.
description:
### About
**We are Chrono24.** The world’s leading online marketplace for luxury watches. Every day, we bring together watch enthusiasts, collectors, dealers, and buyers from all over the world. As a global tech company with strong growth, a highly data-driven culture, and a clear focus on quality and transparency, we are actively shaping the future of the luxury watch market.
For the Chrono24 Group, with subsidiaries in Germany, the UK, the Netherlands, Japan, Hong Kong, and the US, we are looking for an experienced Controlling leader who will help shape our setup and take our financial steering to the next level.

### 

**What you will do: **As Head of Controlling, you will shape the Controlling setup of the Chrono24 Group together with your team. Your main focus will be the further development of our budgeting process, investor reporting, and an efficient cost and revenue controlling framework with strong analytical depth.
You will work closely with the CFO, the Director Data, the business units, and the Finance team to ensure that our steering logic is robust, transparent, and truly useful in day-to-day operations. In this role, you will connect Controlling, Accounting, and Data, turning figures into actionable decisions for the business.

### What you can expect

- You will help shape an international Controlling setup for a growing group structure with multiple subsidiaries.

- You will further develop structured budgeting and forecasting processes and ensure regular, reliable actual vs. plan reviews.

- You will drive clear and effective investor reporting and provide management with solid decision-making input.

- You will challenge numbers, assumptions, and business logic in a constructive way and treat Controlling as a real management tool.

- You will work closely with our Data team, especially Data Analytics, to further develop data-driven and automated reporting and analysis processes.

- You will bring structure to complex topics, set clear priorities, and make sure that reporting, planning, and analysis work in practice.

- You will lead and develop your team, provide direction, and create an environment where strong work can thrive.

- You will bring fresh ideas into Controlling and help evolve the function from a technical, process, and strategic perspective.

### What sets you apart

- Several years of relevant experience in Controlling, ideally gained in a fast-growing international business group.

- First leadership experience and a genuine interest in developing people and taking ownership.

- A structured, analytical mindset and the ability to keep an overview in complex situations.

- Strong skills in budgeting, forecasting, and data analysis.

- The ability to connect financial and operational KPIs and turn them into meaningful steering insights.

- Confident communication skills in both German and English, spoken and written.

- A hands-on mindset, a critical view on existing processes, and the ability to contribute ideas proactively.

- Strong Excel skills, a quick grasp of new systems, and ideally experience with LucaNet.

- A good understanding of modern analytics and AI-supported ways of working, and the ability to use them to make Controlling processes more efficient.

### What we offer

- A strategically important role with real room to shape and build.

- A dynamic, international company with leading Private Equity involvement.

- A modern work environment with flexible hours and hybrid working options.

title: Director of Engineering, Machine Learning Recommendations
summary: Lead engineering strategy for ML-powered recommendation systems and personalized discovery.
description:
### Company Description
Etsy is the global marketplace for unique and creative goods. We build, power, and evolve the tools and technologies that connect millions of entrepreneurs with millions of buyers around the world. As an Etsy employee, you will tackle unique, meaningful, and large-scale problems alongside passionate coworkers, all the while making a rewarding impact and Keeping Commerce Human.

We believe exceptional companies are built by exceptional teams, and we're intentional about it. That means hiring great people, setting them up for success from day one, and giving them real reasons to grow their careers here. We invest in development that goes beyond promotions, and we foster the trust and relationships that help people do their best work together.

### What's the role?
We are looking for a Director of Engineering, Machine Learning to lead Etsy's Recommendations, the team responsible for the algorithms and systems that power personalized onsite-discovery across our marketplace. This is a pivotal technical leadership role at the intersection of ML research, systems engineering, and product impact.

In this role, you will own the end-to-end technical strategy for how Etsy connects buyers with the right listings across the App Homefeed, Web Home, Shop Home, Listing pages, Cart, and Checkout pages. You will lead a team of ML engineers, applied scientists, and system engineers organized across three areas: candidate retrieval, ranking, and recommendation systems. You will drive the evolution of our models from state-of-the-art multi-interest retrieval and multi-task deep ranking to next-generation LLM-powered foresight recommendations and generative discovery experiences. The biggest unsolved challenge in front of this team is not just relevance, it is inspiration: helping buyers discover new ideas and start new shopping missions.

This opportunity is a full-time position reporting to the VP of Engineering at Search, Recommendations, and Ads.

### What's this team like at Etsy?
The Recommendations organization sits at the heart of Etsy's marketplace. We own over 60 recommendation modules across Etsy's surfaces, with our most impactful work powering the App Homefeed, Web Home, Shop Home, Listing pages, Cart, and Checkout pages. 

Our ML stack spans the full recommendation pipeline. On retrieval, we build and evolve our multi-interest user-to-listing embedding model as well as a LLM-powered system that generates forward-looking shopping ideas based on buyer personas. On ranking, we operate a multi-task deep ranking model jointly optimizing for clicks, favorites, ads-to-cart, and purchases. Underpinning all of this is ReactorRecs, our in-house serving and orchestration platform that composes retrieval, ranking, filtering, and experimentation across 200+ recommendation modules.

We believe in research grounded in real user impact. We run rigorous offline and online experiments, use LLM-based and human-in-the-loop evaluation, and hold ourselves to both engagement and discovery metrics.

### What does the day-to-day look like?

- Define and drive the multi-year product and technical roadmap for Recommendations ML, with particular focus on personalization, foresight, diversity, and content freshness, the four problems where we have the most room to grow.

- Lead and grow a team of ML engineers, applied scientists, and platform engineers across retrieval, ranking, and systems sub-teams, each with its own engineering manager.

Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town, we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.

We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.

### About this role

The Discovery pillar's mission is to make it easy and delightful for retailers to find brands and products their customers will love. This role owns the vision for how retailers experience Faire across our app and across the core components of the buying journey.

We are looking for an experience PM with strong design taste and a track record of leading work across teams at a scaled consumer company. You will set the north star for the Faire mobile app and for the shared components that underpin the buying experience on Faire (e.g., product and brand tiles, product grid, filters, and global navigation), and you will make sure the work that many contributing teams do adds up to one cohesive experience.

- Own the vision and strategy for the Faire app, grounded in what retailers want and say about it.

- Own the vision for our core buying-journey components, including product tile, brand tile, product grid, filters, and global navigation, and set how they work across surfaces.

- Define the metrics that quantify the impact of experience improvements, and build a shared view of impact across contributing teams.

- Partner with design, engineering, and PM leaders across Discovery and other pillars to make shared components scale across surfaces.

- Serve as the subject matter expert for the components you own, partnering with teams that build on them to reach better solutions more efficiently.

### ###
- Represent the app and experience strategy to senior leadership.

### ###

### Qualifications

- 7+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex, scaled user-facing experiences, ideally at a marketplace or e-commerce company.

- Strong design and UX craft and taste, with a point of view on what great looks like.

- A track record of leading work across multiple teams you did not manage, and bringing them toward one vision.

- Deep expertise in your product area and a reputation as a collaborative partner that other teams seek out.

- Analytical skills: you define success metrics and quantify the impact of experience changes.

- Platform thinking: you think beyond the use case in front of you to how a solution scales across other experiences.

### About Rare Candy
Rare Candy is revolutionizing the $25 billion trading-card industry as the only community marketplace 100% dedicated to TCGs. Collectors use our AI-powered card scanner, data-rich collection tools, and expert-curated Instapacks to buy, sell, rip, and showcase Pokémon, MTG, Lorcana, One Piece, and more. We've hit 30x revenue growth year to date, the business is profitable, and we're building the team to take this from a great product to a category-defining platform. We're a 25-person team moving fast and looking for the next set of TCG-obsessed rock stars to join our team.

### The Role
You'll build the Instapacks that thousands of collectors rip every week. You'll turn our vault inventory into packs people love: picking chases collectors will love, creating themes and curating cards, setting run sizes, checking every pack's value and margin, and getting each print run live on time. Then you'll tell collectors about it, with drop announcements, pull highlights, and the stories behind the chases.

This role is for someone who lives in the hobby and is fluent in numbers. You can price a slab from memory, and you can build the spreadsheet that shows what a 5,000-pack run does to margin. You'll work side by side with our pack builder and warehouse team in Dallas.

### What Success Looks Like
**First 30 days:** You know our inventory, our tools, and every live pack. You've shipped your first print runs with review, and you're posting drop and pull content every week.
**First few months:** You own the weekly build calendar. Packs launch on time, hit their value and margin targets, and sell through. You catch inventory problems before they reach a live pack.
**By the end of year one:** You run pack building and drop marketing day to day. You've improved our pack templates and tools, and you're training the next pack builder.

### What You'll Do

- **Build print runs from live inventory:** choose chases, set run sizes and pack structure, and check every pack against our value, floor, and margin rules before launch.

- **Keep the lineup fresh:** a steady mix across price points and games, with Pokémon today and One Piece growing.

- **Watch the numbers daily:** sell-through, pulls, and Keep versus Exchange. Flag what's working, what's stuck, and what we need to buy.

- **Work with the warehouse:** intake, inventory accuracy, and on-time launches.

- **Tell the story:** write and post drop announcements, weekly top-pull highlights, and pack stories with our content team.

- **Feed the buy plan:** tell sourcing which cards and price points we're short on.

### You Might Be a Fit If

- You're a serious collector or player. You follow sets, prices, and grading, and you can spot a fake.

- You're good with numbers: comfortable in spreadsheets, expected value, and basic probability. Experience using AI tools like Claude is a plus.

- You are immersed in the TCG hobby. You know what cards are trending, when new sets drop what the top chases will be. You’ve bought, sold, traded and graded cards for a long time and it shows.

- You've bought, sold, or priced cards for real: at a card shop, as a show dealer or Whatnot seller, at an auction house, grading company, distributor, or marketplace.

- You write in a collector's voice. Comfort on camera or running social

Join our research team as a Member of Technical Staff (MTS), Law Research, where you'll help define the frontier of AI-powered legal reasoning. You will conduct applied research, develop methodologies for assessing legal intelligence in AI systems, and partner closely with researchers and engineers to shape the next generation of enterprise AI.

Design, own, and evolve evaluation frameworks for AI agents operating in legal domains, including benchmark suites, scoring methodologies, quality rubrics, and research-grade evaluation protocols.
Conduct original research on legal reasoning, statutory interpretation, legal analysis, and workflow automation.
Develop and curate datasets, case studies, and benchmark environments that reflect real-world legal challenges.
Collaborate with AI researchers and engineers to evaluate and improve legal-focused models and agentic systems.
Analyze model performance, reasoning quality, and failure modes across legal use cases.
Publish internal research findings, best practices, and evaluation methodologies.
Stay current with developments in legal technology, jurisprudence, regulatory environments, and AI research.
Help establish industry-leading standards for legal AI evaluation and benchmarking.

What We're Looking For

Advanced degree in Law (JD, LLM, SJD, PhD in Law, or equivalent).
Deep expertise in one or more legal domains, including corporate law, contracts, litigation, regulatory compliance, intellectual property, employment law, or public policy.
Demonstrated experience conducting legal research, analysis, or policy work.
Experience developing structured methodologies for assessing legal arguments, legal outcomes, or research quality.
Exceptional analytical reasoning and written communication skills.
Experience working across interdisciplinary teams involving research, technology, or legal operations.

Preferred Qualifications

Background in legal benchmarking, legal research methodology, or legal knowledge management.
Published legal scholarship, policy research, or contributions to legal standards and frameworks.

description:
### About Pickle
Pickle is a peer-to-peer rental marketplace unlocking the value of the billions of underutilized items sitting in consumers’ closets. We make it easy to rent high-quality items exactly when you need them with fast, convenient fulfillment and an on-demand experience that’s as seamless as shopping.
We’re building a new kind of commerce layer: one powered by dynamic local supply, where access is more convenient. Pickle is now live nationwide and scaling rapidly. Our marketplace already features **600K+ items**, and we’re just getting started. We’re excited to extend our vision beyond fashion into every category.
We've raised **$20M to date from FirstMark, Craft, Burst Capital, FJ Labs**, and others.

### About This Role
The Director of Ops & Logistics will design and own the fulfillment network of Pickle's marketplace. This is a zero-to-one buildout: the systems, networks, and partnerships that sit underneath every transaction don't fully exist yet. You will build them.
We're looking for someone who lives and breathes marketplaces. Who instinctively understands that every operational decision has two sides, and that the right fulfillment network doesn't just move items, it builds supply-side trust and unlocks demand. You've seen what happens when liquidity meets logistics friction, and you know how to fix it.
This isn't a role for someone who optimizes existing systems or warehouses. We will continue to primarily use 3rd party partners to power our fulfillment and we do not own or touch any of the inventory. It's for someone who has stared at a blank whiteboard and built the network from scratch. Who gets excited by the unit economics before the infrastructure exists, and who sees a neighborhood dry cleaner not as a vendor but as a distribution node.

### What You'll Own
### *Fulfillment Architecture*

- Design and operate a logistics network that includes: on-demand courier, pick up/drop off locations, and national/regional shipping.

- Negotiate volume-based contracts with courier partners (Uber, DoorDash, Roadie/UPS, regional carriers).

### *Dynamic Pricing & Unit Economics*

- Build and launch a dynamic pricing engine that aligns delivery cost with urgency, distance, and item value.

- Own the ops P&L: delivery margin, item protection/insurance, etc.

### *Drop Off Locations*

- Build Pickle's neighborhood-level network from scratch: drop-off/pickup points across dry cleaners, boutiques, lockers, coffee shops.

- Assess the opportunitya and potentially lead the procurement, branding, and deployment Pickle's own transport fleet in select markets.

### Requirements

- 8+ years in operations, logistics, or marketplace strategy, with direct experience building and scaling multi-market first-mile and last-mile logistics networks

- Proven track record with asset-light, partner-operated networks (not warehouse ownership. We're building on aligned incentives, not fixed costs)

- Experience with dual-sided marketplaces or peer-to-peer platforms; understands supply-side and demand-side dynamics simultaneously

- Analytically sharp: you build unit economics models before you sign contracts and own the P&L

- Track record of reducing cost per transaction meaningfully: through carrier negotiation, routing optimization, or network design

- NYC-based and in-office; this is a hands-on, on-the-ground role.

### Benefits

- Competitive compensation and equity

- Healthcare (Medical, Dental, Vision)

- Take what you need paid time off

Thumbtack is the one app you need to take care of and improve your home, from personalized guidance to AI tools and a best-in-class hiring experience. The Business Applications org builds and operates the internal systems that keep Thumbtack running at scale: Salesforce-centered workflows, admin tooling, and the integrations that connect teams across the company. summary: Coordinate multi-site fleet logistics and operational workflows for robotics technology projects.
description:
Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Our AI-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI. Backed by world-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we’re looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works.

**Location**: Bengaluru (On-site) + multi-city coordination 

**Instawork Robotics Lab (IRL)
**
Robots are getting smarter, but they still can’t reliably do the everyday physical tasks people do, chopping vegetables, stocking shelves, assembling parts. The bottleneck is data. UC Berkeley’s Prof. Ken Goldberg calls it the “100,000-year data gap”: the chasm between the massive text datasets used to train language models and the tiny amount of real-world, physical-dexterity data available to train robots. The entire robotics industry collected only ~100,000 hours of training data in 2024 and ~1 million in 2025, and even the ~20 million hours projected for 2026 is still less than 0.04% of what is ultimately needed. IRL exists to close that gap. Using Instacore, a wearable multi-camera and sensor system (head, chest, and wrist cameras plus IMUs and a compute pack), our field teams capture synchronized, high-diversity egocentric data of real people doing real tasks across real commercial environments: kitchens, warehouses, hotels, retail, and light manufacturing. That data is quality-checked, anonymized, and delivered to the world’s leading robotics companies and foundation-model labs to teach robots how to operate in the messy physical world. In India, we run the on-ground engine of this mission, a growing fleet of Instacore rigs, Field Officers and Data Collectors, regional hubs, and the operations and finance backbone that keeps it all running at quality and scale.

**Role Overview
**
The Operations Associate, Fleet Manager keeps the Instacore fleet moving. You own visibility and control over where every rig is, what condition it is in, and whether it is ready to record, making sure faulty rigs get back to the hubs fast, SD cards are rotated and fully accounted for, and Field Officers have the travel and logistics they need to be in the right place at the right time. When the fleet flows, recordings flow, and closing the data gap depends on it.

**Key Responsibilities
**
1. Fleet Tracking, Maintain a live, accurate view of every rig across cities and hubs (deployed, in-transit, idle, faulty, in-repair), tracked at serial-number level.
2. Faulty Rig Recovery, Ensure faulty rigs are pulled from the field and returned to hubs quickly; coordinate with QC / Hardware for repair or replacement; minimize downtime and idle assets.
3. SD Card Rotation, Manage the SD-card pool end to end: issue, collect, track, and rotate cards so data is offloaded promptly and clean cards are always available in the field; prevent loss.
4. Travel Desk Coordination, Work closely with the travel desk to arrange Field Officer bookings, travel, and accommodation so deployments happen on time and cost-effectively.
5. Hub & Inter-City Coordination, Coordinate inbound/outbound movement of rigs between hubs and field; ensure the right rigs reach the right cities to match the pipeline.
6. Loss & Reconciliation, Run daily reconciliation of rigs and SD cards; follow up relentlessly on overdue or miss

# UAS Operations Specialist - Pilot

## About the Role

As a UAS Operations Specialist, you’ll join Flight Operations as a pilot supporting commercial drone delivery under Part 135. All hires complete the company’s FAA approved training, aircraft qualification, and checking requirements before serving as Remote Pilot in Command (RPIC) and maintain required recurrent training, currency, and proficiency.

Qualified pilots may be selected as a Flight Instructor, Ground Instructor, or Check Pilot based on experience, demonstrated proficiency, and program needs. These assignments require additional qualification, evaluation, company designation, and FAA approval where required.

You’ll also support Part 107 flight testing, developmental operations, and system validation as assigned, working alongside Flight Test and cross-functional teams within applicable FAA authorizations, operating limitations, and established safety controls.

* Maintain accurate flight, training, qualification, currency, and operational records, including test observations and reports required for assigned activities.
* Participate in standardization and safety reporting, and contribute operational expertise to SOPs, manuals, checklists, training materials, and flight procedures.

title: Senior Software Engineer
summary: Build and scale high-quality software applications for a luxury watch marketplace.
description:
## The role

As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll own projects end to end: from shaping the problem with product and operations, through design and implementation across backend, web, iOS, and Android, to release and the results that follow.

We organize engineering around projects, not codebases. There are no "backend engineers" or "iOS engineers" here. Each project has an engineer who owns its delivery and goes wherever the work goes. Every codebase still has an owner responsible for its long-term health, standards, and code review, and you'll likely own one or more yourself. But no one is dedicated to a single codebase full time.

You'll report to our CTO and be an early member of a small, senior team, with real influence over core architecture decisions and how we work as we scale.

## What you'll do

* Own project delivery end to end. Take a project from a business goal to a shipped, measured result. You're accountable for scope, technical plan, timeline, quality, and launch.
* Work across the full stack. Build backend services and APIs, web experiences, and native iOS/Android features, depending on what the project needs, not what your title says.
* Shape the work with stakeholders. Partner with product, design, growth, and operations to turn goals into clear plans, flag tradeoffs early, and keep everyone informed as the project moves.
* Steward a codebase. Own the long-term health of one or more of our codebases: set standards, review changes from engineers working across it, and keep it maintainable as many hands touch it.
* Make sound technical decisions. Contribute to architecture discussions, write design docs for meaningful changes, and reason clearly about product, performance, and security tradeoffs.
* Raise the bar. Champion modern engineering practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and thoughtful use of AI-assisted development tools. Mentor others and help define our engineering culture as we grow.

## You should apply if you

* Have hands-on experience building and shipping production software, with a track record of projects you led from idea to launch.
* Are strong in at least two of backend, web, and native mobile, and are eager to work across all three.
* Take pride in designing, building, and maintaining APIs, services, and systems at scale.
* Care about polished, high-quality user experiences, and sweat the details that make an app feel great.
* Thrive on ownership: you see problems through to the end and hold yourself to a high standard, without waiting to be told what's next.
* Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, in writing and in person.
* Adapt quickly to changing requirements and stay effective in ambiguous situations.
* Uphold best practices in engineering, security, and design.
* Have a passion for watches and fine craftsmanship (a plus, not a requirement).

## Our stack

* Backend: Java, JAX-RS, and SQL
* Web: TypeScript, React (Next.js), and Angular
* Mobile: Swift + UIKit (iOS) and Java/Kotlin (Android)
* Infrastructure: Docker and Jetty / NGINX on Google Cloud Platform; GitHub Actions for CI/CD

### About the role
Our mobile app, Zable, is how most of our customers experience all of our products in one centralised space. It's written in React Native and TypeScript with a Kotlin backend, shipped to iOS and Android from a single codebase. We are now looking to level up the quality engineering so that we can raise release cadence without losing sleep over regressions.
This is an automation-first role. You'll spend most of your time writing code - test frameworks, CI tooling, helpers, rather than executing test scripts by hand. You'll work alongside software engineers, product, and design, setting direction.
You'll also be working at the frontier of AI-assisted quality, using LLMs and AI tooling to speed up test authoring, triage failures, and surface coverage gaps, while applying the engineering judgement to keep tests trustworthy.

### What you'll be doing
### Own the mobile test strategy:

- Define and evolve a pragmatic test pyramid for React Native - deciding where E2E is worth the weight and where logic belongs in faster layers (Jest, React Testing Library, component tests).

- Make deliberate calls about coverage, reliability, and speed trade-offs across the app.

- Set the bar for what "ready to ship" looks like on mobile, and hold the line on it.

### Build reliable E2E automation:

- Create and maintain mobile E2E suites in Maestro, including the scaffolding around them - test data, device configuration, helpers, reporting.

- Integrate suites into CI (GitHub Actions) so engineers get fast, trustworthy feedback on every PR and release candidates carry a signal people actually believe.

- Drive flakiness down and time-to-diagnosis down. We treat a flaky test the same way we treat a broken test, and we expect root-cause work rather than retry-until-green.

### Bring AI into the SDLC:

- Use AI tools day-to-day to accelerate test authoring, cluster failures, surface coverage insights, and propose fixes.

- Decide where AI adds leverage and where a human eye is needed.

title: Staff Technical Program Manager, Cross-Functional Programs
summary: Lead complex cross-functional technical programs to drive business growth and product development.
description:
Who we are: 
At Rover, pets and their people are at the heart of everything we do. We connect pet parents with trusted pet care across the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Australia.
Headquartered in Seattle and Barcelona, we’re a values driven, fast-growing tech company focused on building safe and personalized experiences tailored to the needs of each unique pet. We’re investing in AI as a business accelerator and provide every team member access to AI tools in service of creating better experiences for our community.
We are proud to be recognized as a great place to work, having been named among the 100 Best Companies to Work For in Seattle Business Magazine and Washington’s Best Workplaces in the Puget Sound Business Journal. At Rover we’re committed to creating an accessible, inclusive, and welcoming community, which starts with our employees.
Want to make an impact? Join our pack and come work (and play!) with us.

Who We're Looking For
Some programs at Rover don't belong to any one team. They pull in product, engineering, data, operations, and the business all at once, and they're the ones that matter most: the platform bet that changes how three orgs build, the flagship feature that can't ship until four teams build against the same plan, the problem everyone agrees is important and nobody can quite scope.
Those programs need someone who owns them outright. You'll join Rover's Technical Program Management team, a small and growing function that sits at the center of how engineering delivers complex, cross-functional work. TPMs here own how programs get executed, drive alignment across organizational boundaries, and bring structured thinking to the hardest problems on the roadmap, all in service of better experiences for the pet parents and sitters who depend on our platform every day.
Your scope is defined by difficulty rather than by domain. Some programs land with you because of their complexity, ambiguity, and visibility, not because of which part of the product they touch. Others you'll find yourself: you'll see the program Rover needs before anyone has named it, and make the case for it. You'll go deep enough in each domain to be genuinely useful, then do it again somewhere else. You'll often carry more than one of these at once, and your work will shape how engineering sets its priorities and OKRs, not just how a single program delivers.
Problems arrive without shape, and your first job is to give them one: a problem statement the room can commit to, a scope with an explicit boundary, named owners and decision rights, and a definition of success set before the build starts. Your second is the technical judgment to be a true peer to engineering: reading a dependency chain, evaluating trade-offs without needing full translation, knowing when to slow down and build the durable thing versus speed up and take on debt deliberately, and spotting where we're walking through a one-way door. You won't just run a playbook. You'll help write it, turning each program into repeatable patterns, and helping the TPMs around you get sharper too.
Most of it comes down to judgment. The role is a steady run of calls with no obviously right answer: when to force a decision and when to let a team keep exploring, when to escalate and when escalating costs more than the delay it saves, when good enough now beats correct later. What matters isn't whether you follow a process, it's whether those instincts are calibrated and you can explain them afterward.

### 　**組織・チームのミッション**

AI Enablementは、メルカリグループにおけるこれからのプロダクト開発のあり方（Mercari AI PDLC：Product Development Life Cycle）を設計する組織です。私たちのミッションは、Marketplace、FinTech、Cross-Borderの各事業を横断し、グループのプロダクト開発プロセスをAIネイティブなものへと転換することです。

私たちの顧客は社内にいます。プロダクトマネジメント、エンジニアリング、デザイン、QA、BI、マーケティング、コンプライアンス・法務など、開発プロセスに関わるすべての職種が対象です。プロダクトチームとともに、現場で本当に役立つものを見極め、共通サービスを担うエンジニアリングチームと連携して、効果が実証された取り組みをグループ全体が安心して使える仕組みへと育てます。

AIの能力は四半期ごとに変化しています。私たちは、AIが今できることを明確に把握するとともに、6〜12か月後にできるようになることについての見解を示し、その両方を踏まえて計画を立てます。提供するのは、よりよい働き方です。その成果は、チームがどれだけ広く取り入れ、継続して使っているかで測ります。

AIを前提とした開発体制のもと、スピードと顧客価値の最大化を同時に追求します。プロダクトマネージャーは、最も重要な課題発見（Discovery）と事業成果（Outcome）に集中し、AIネイティブな方法でプロダクトを前進させます。

AIによって、一人ひとりが担える役割の範囲は広がります。少人数のチームでも一つのプロダクト領域全体を担えるようになるため、そうしたチームを増やし、より多くの顧客価値を並行して追求します。各チームは課題の発見からリリースまで一貫して自分たちの領域に責任を持ち、何をつくり、何をリリースするかという判断を担い続けます。

-   メルカリのミッションとバリューの詳細は、[こちら](https://careers.mercari.com/jp/mission-values/)をご覧ください。

### 　**業務内容**

メルカリでは、複数の事業にわたり、数百人のエンジニア、プロダクトマネージャー、デザイナー、QAエンジニア、アナリストがプロダクトを開発しています。このポジションでは、彼らがどのように働くか、すなわち利用するツール、実践するプラクティス、運用するプロセスに責任を持ちます。

向き合うのは、「AIエージェントが実装・テスト・レビューの多くを担えるようになったとき、私たちの開発プロセスの理想形は何か。そして、そこにたどり着くために何を変える必要があるか」という問いです。完成された答えを持つ企業はまだありません。チームとともに答えを見つけ、動くソフトウェアでその有効性を実証し、メルカリの開発のあり方として定着させていきます。

### 　**主な業務**

-   **1. メルカリのプロダクト開発のあり方に関する戦略とロードマップを担う**

-   メルカリにおけるAIネイティブな開発の姿を定義する。対象となるツール、プラクティス、プロセスと、それらを変えていく順序を明確にする
-   チームの現場、市場、自らの実験から得た根拠をもとに次の取り組みを決め、経営陣や各職能のリードと計画について合意する
-   計画を常に見直す。より確かな根拠が得られたら計画を変更し、何を根拠に変えたのかを明らかにする

-   **2. 解くべき課題を見つける**

-   グループ全体のプロダクトチームと直接協働し、現在の働き方のどこに時間のロスや品質上の課題があるかを把握する。実際の業務を観察することを、最も確かな手がかりとする
-   得られた発見を優先順位付きの仮説に落とし込み、それぞれの成功条件について事前に合意する
-   AIツールを活用し、リサーチ、分析、プロトタイピングをスプリント単位ではなく数日単位で進める

-   **3. プロトタイプをつくり、効果を実証する**

-   プロトタイプから始める。ドキュメントよりも動くもののほうが早く問いに答えられるなら、動くものをつくる
-   パイロットを始める前に、業務が変わる当事者であるチームと成功基準を定め、その基準に照らして結果を評価する
-   どの実験を本格導入に進めるかを判断する。数多くのAIツールを試すなかで、継続利用に値するものは一部に限られる。それらをプラットフォームサービスへと育て、その後は全社のチームへの展開に取り組む

-   **4. 活用を広げ、定着を確認する**

-   リリースから実際の利用までの道筋を設計する。オンボーディング、ドキュメント、研修、そして必要な人に適切なタイミングで届く社内コミュニケーションを整える
-   イネーブルメントそのものをプロダクトとして扱う。ユーザー、品質基準、測定可能な指標を持つものとして設計する
-   利用の広がりとアウトプットの品質をあわせて追跡し、次の打ち手を決める。チームの仕事が速くなり、成果物もよくなるよう、両方の改善を目指す

-   **5. 開発ライフサイクルに関わるすべての職種と協働する**

-   プロダクトマネジメント、エンジニアリング、デザイン、QA、BI、マーケティング、コンプライアンス・法務と連携する。各職種がそれぞれの基準に責任を持ちながら、何を変えるか、どこからを各チームの裁量とするかについて共通認識を築く
-   AIが今できること、今後1年以内にできるようになること、そしてそれが目の前の意思決定に何を意味するかについて、明確な見解を経営陣に示す

### 　  
業務で利用するツールの例

-   **汎用チャット・生成AI**：Claude、Gemini
-   **ナレッジに関するQ&A・リサーチ支援**：Notion AI、NotebookLM（ドキュメントのアップロードとQ&A）
-   **開発支援（コード補完・コーディングエージェント・IDE）**：Claude Code、Cursor、GitHub Copilot、Devin、Codex、Gemini Code Assist
-   **ワークフロー自動化・AIアプリ開発（ノーコード・ローコード）**：Zapier、n8n

### 　**このポジションならではの挑戦**

-   **対象は全社です。** 変革の影響は、一つのプロダクトの一機能にとどまらず、複数の事業にわたる数百人の日々の仕事に及びます
-   **自ら手を動かし続けます。** プロトタイピングは業務の一部です。最新のツールを使って実際にものをつくる時間を持ち、社内で誰よりも早く試すことも少なくありません
-   **答えはまだありません。** AIネイティブなプロダクト開発について、完成された実践ガイドを持つ企業はまだありません。メルカ

title: SMB Business Development Representative
summary: Prospect SMB vacation rental managers to drive product adoption and book sales meetings.
description:
About the role

We're hiring an SMB Business Development Representative to help small and mid-sized vacation rental property managers discover WanderOS.

You'll be the first conversation many operators have with us. You'll prospect into SMB property management companies, open conversations by phone, email, and LinkedIn, qualify their needs, and book strong first meetings for our Account Executives. You'll learn the vacation rental technology ecosystem quickly and help operators see how WanderOS can grow their direct bookings without replacing the PMS they already use.

This is a high-activity, high-ownership role on a growing sales team, and a great path into an Account Executive seat for someone who wants to grow fast.

Location: Austin, TX (onsite).

What you'll do

Prospect into small and mid-sized vacation rental property management companies through calls, email, LinkedIn, and other channels.
Run high-volume outbound sequences and follow up on inbound leads quickly.
Lead short discovery conversations to understand each operator's business, current systems, and direct-booking goals.
Qualify prospects and book well-prepared meetings for Account Executives.
Keep accurate activity, lead, and pipeline records in our CRM.
Test and refine messaging, and share what you hear from the market with sales, marketing, and product.
Hit and exceed weekly and monthly targets for meetings booked and qualified pipeline.

What you bring

1+ years in a BDR, SDR, or other quota-carrying sales role, ideally selling software to small businesses.
Comfort with high-volume cold calling and outbound prospecting.
Clear, confident written and verbal communication.
Curiosity about how operators run their businesses, and the ability to ask good questions.
Resilience, coachability, and a strong work ethic.
Organization and follow-through: you keep your pipeline clean and never drop a lead.
Experience with a CRM and sales engagement tools.

Nice to have

Experience in vacation rentals, hospitality, travel, or property management.
Familiarity with PMS platforms or vacation rental software.
Comfort using AI tools to research accounts and personalize outreach.

What success looks like

Consistently hitting meeting and pipeline targets.
Booking meetings that turn into real opportunities for our Account Executives.
Becoming a trusted voice of the market for the team.
Growing into an Account Executive role.

Why Wander

Help vacation rental operators grow their direct-booking businesses. You'll join a growing Austin sales team, learn from experienced sellers, and have a clear path to grow your career.

Wander is an equal opportunity employer. We're committed to building a team with a range of backgrounds and perspectives, and we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected characteristic.

Use AI tools to accelerate research, audience insight, creative iteration, reporting, analysis, and workflow automation
Stay current on platform updates, privacy changes, and new ad products, and translate them into what we should do differently

2, 3 years of hands-on paid social experience, with meaningful time as the person actually building and optimizing campaigns
Demonstrated fluency in Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads; working proficiency in at least one of LinkedIn Ads or TikTok Ads
Comfortable working with trac

title: Events Marketer

description:
About the role

We're hiring an Events Marketer to own Wander and WanderOS events from strategy through follow-up.

Events are one of the most important ways we meet vacation rental and hospitality operators. You'll plan and run our presence at industry conferences and trade shows, host our own field events and customer gatherings, and make sure every event turns into real pipeline and relationships for the sales team. Build and manage the annual events calendar across industry conferences, trade shows, and Wander-hosted events.
Run event logistics end to end: vendors, booths, venues, travel, shipping, and on-site execution.
Plan and host field events, dinners, and customer gatherings for prospects and partners.
Partner with sales on pre-event outreach, meeting booking, and post-event follow-up.
Work with creative on booth design, signage, swag, and event content.
Manage event budgets and vendor relationships.
Track and report on event results: attendance, meetings, pipeline, and ROI.
Build repeatable playbooks so every event runs smoothly.

What we're looking for

Required

3+ years of event marketing or field marketing experience, ideally in B2B software.

Strong project management and attention to detail, with the ability to juggle many events at once.
Experience managing budgets and vendors.
Comfort partnering with sales and tying events to pipeline.
Excellent communication and a calm, solutions-oriented presence on site.

Comfort with AI tools to move faster on planning, content, and reporting.

Experience in travel, hospitality, vacation rentals, or property management.
Relationships with vendors and organizers in the vacation rental or hospitality industry.
Experience with event and marketing tools such as HubSpot or Salesforce.

title: FinTech Operations Graduate (Customer Support)

description:
### About Lendable
Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.** **We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

- One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

- Among the** fastest-growing tech** companies in the UK

- Profitable since **2017**

- Backed by top investors including **Balderton Capital **and** Goldman Sachs**

- **Loved by customers** with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on [Trustpilot](https://uk.trustpilot.com/review/lendable.co.uk))

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch:** loans, credit cards and car finance**. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks **with dated systems and painful processes.**

### Join us if you want to

- **Take ownership: **you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

- **Work in small teams of exceptional people:** Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

- **Build the best technology in-house**: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

### About the role
This is an entry-level role for someone who wants to start a career in operations at a financial services firm. You'll join our UK Customer Operations team and train to become a fully competent front-line agent, supporting customers across our personal loans, credit cards and car finance. That covers everything from general service queries to more intricate financial support situations. By taking ownership of every enquiry from first contact to final resolution, you will not only deliver exceptional customer outcomes but also provide actionable feedback and insights to help improve our automated tools and AI-driven customer journeys
You'll be based in our Chatham office three days a week and work two weekend days a month (one Saturday and one Sunday), with a day in lieu the week before so you never work more than five days in a week.

### What you'll be doing

- Resolving general customer service and financial support queries across any one of our products in either loans, cards or car finance over multiple channels, following established processes

- Owning each enquiry from first contact to resolution, or escalating it to the right place when it needs to go further

- Supporting customers in financial difficulty or in vulnerable situations: listening actively, asking the right questions to understand their circumstances, and finding the right support option for them

- Keeping conversations on track while building rapport and trust, so every outcome is both positive for the customer and compliant

- Meeting your targets for customer satisfaction, quality and compliance by following procedures carefully and using judgement where a customer's situation calls for it, and logging every interaction accurately for audit and learning

- Using AI and digital tools to resolve queries faster and more accurately

- Feeding back blockers, process gaps and recurring issues to the relevant teams, and taking part in process reviews that improve our knowledge base, training

A critical role to help the business understand how it can serve customers better.

### Some of the areas you'll delve into are:

- The regulatory framework for complaints: FCA regulation, the DISP rules, Consumer Duty, and how the guidance is applied to real cases.

- Investigation technique: gathering evidence, interrogating system records and call recordings, and testing what actually happened against what should have happened.

- Decision making and redress: reaching fair and objective outcomes, and calculating and explaining any compensation due.

- Customer communication: writing final response letters that break complex issues down into plain English.

- The Financial Ombudsman Service: how cases are referred, how FOS reaches its view, and how we apply those learnings to future cases.

- Root cause and feedback: spotting the product and process failures behind complaints and feeding them back to frontline and product teams.

Reporting to a Complaints Manager within the Operations Team, you will be responsible for a live caseload and for the quality of the decisions you make on it.
